sources.title: SOF International Science Olympiad (ISO) Syllabus Class 2
sources.notes: Official SOF page. Current Class 2 science scope includes Plants, Animals, Human Body, Food, Housing and Clothing, Family and Festivals, Good Habits and Safety Rules, Transport and Communication, Air, Water and Rocks, and Earth and Universe, plus logical reasoning and higher-order questions.

sources.title: Class 2 International Science Olympiad Workbook
sources.notes: Official SOF catalog page identifies the workbook as the 2026-27 edition and lists the current Class 2 ISO chapter structure.

sources.title: SOF International Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2026-27
sources.notes: Official SOF sample paper confirms 35 questions: 5 Logical Reasoning at 1 mark each, 25 Science at 1 mark each, and 5 Achievers at 2 marks each, for 40 marks total. It also demonstrates mixed formats including statement evaluation, visual questions, word manipulation and higher-order inference. It supports assessment-format design, not exact row-level curriculum placement.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2025-26
sources.notes: Immediate-prior-year official SOF Class 2 science sample paper with reproducibly inspectable pages. Historical direct evidence counts only where current 2026-27 official scope separately retains the relevant topic family.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2024-25
sources.notes: Historical official SOF Class 2 science sample paper. It supersedes the redundant 2023-24 evidence source for repeated text-verifiable skin, cousin, wool/winter and tonga items while current-year scope is anchored separately.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2022-23
sources.notes: Historical official SOF Class 2 science sample paper. Its plant diagram directly labels a leaf and asks which plant part makes food; historical evidence remains bound to current 2026-27 Plants scope.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2019-20
sources.notes: Historical official SOF Class 2 science sample paper. It may support direct evidence that a fact or skill has been assessed at Class 2 in SOF only when current-year official scope separately retains the relevant topic family. It does not by itself prove 2026-27 row placement or recurrence.
